title: Inbound Shipments and the Inbound Placement Fee (FBN)
content:
Inbound shipments to Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) may be sent only while the enrollment is active; a shipment already created before a suspension or an exit request is still received. Each received SKU line records the units received against the units declared on the shipment plan. The inbound placement fee is billed per unit on the shipment plan at the rate of the placement option the seller chose: minimal split, partial split or Northloop-optimized split.

## What a received line shows

Each SKU line of an inbound shipment, once receiving closes for it, records the shipment number, the SKU and its size tier, the units received, the units expected (declared on the shipment plan) and the declared unit cost on the shipment plan.

## The placement fee

The inbound placement fee of a shipment is the units on the shipment plan multiplied by the per-unit placement rate of the option chosen, rounded to the cent. The rate is the program's minimal split rate when the seller ships to a single fulfillment center, the partial split rate for two or three centers, and the Northloop-optimized split rate when the seller follows Northloop's optimized split.

Illustration (hypothetical figures, not a program rate): a shipment plan of 400 units under an option priced at 0.20 USD per unit bills 80.00 USD. The fee is charged on the units on the shipment plan, so a shortfall at receiving does not change it.

## Sending versus receiving

| Enrollment status when the shipment is created | New shipment may be sent | Shipment created earlier is still received |
|---|---|---|
| active | yes | yes |
| inbound suspended | no | yes |
| winding down after an exit request | no | yes |
